# `vector_cosine_similarity`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the cosine similarity between two float vectors.
The vectors must have the same dimension.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.2 and later.

## Syntax

```text
vector_cosine_similarity(array1, array2)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `vector_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- vector_cosine_similarity, example 1
> SELECT vector_cosine_similarity(array(1.0F, 2.0F, 3.0F), array(4.0F, 5.0F, 6.0F));
0.9746319
```
